newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: ING to syndicate $150 mln loan for Petron.
newsitem.headline: ING to syndicate $150 mln loan for Petron.

text.p: ING Barings said on Monday it would syndicate a $150 million loan for Philippine oil refiner Petron Corp.
The co-arrangers of the loan are Canadian Imperial Bank of Commerce, Dresdner (Southeast Asia) Ltd, and Korea Development Bank.

In a statement, ING Barings country manager Renato de Guzman said foreign lenders were keen on extending the loan to Petron which would use the proceeds to build a sulphur recovery unit for its oil refinery in Bataan, northwest of Manila.
The unit, which is to be completed in 1999, will reduce sulphur dioxide emissions while producing unleaded gasoline and low-sulphur diesel.
